title: METALEAD: A Comprehensive Human-Curated Leaderboard Dataset for Transparent Reporting of Machine Learning Experiments

bias_targets.methodology: Curating a comprehensive, human-annotated leaderboard dataset (METALEAD) that extracts all experimental results from machine learning papers—including weak baselines, ablations, and negative outcomes—to counteract selective reporting and provide full experimental context.

Capturing and categorizing failed variants and non-state-of-the-art results within the dataset schema to mitigate the field's tendency to favor and publish only positive, best-performing outcomes (performance myopia).

Providing structured "experiment-type guided comparisons" (e.g., separating proposed methods from baselines) and cross-domain test sets to prevent users from seeing only a curated success narrative that reinforces pre-existing expectations of model superiority.
